name: Zmey Gorynych

crownPassive.name: Five heads
crownPassive.text: When he attacks, five heads strike five random enemy cards anywhere on the board, each for his Attack. He still needs an enemy card in reach to attack. If there are fewer than five, a card can be hit more than once.

bond.name: Rus' kin
bond.text: Your other Rus' heroes have +1 Speed.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Three heads: strikes the card three times, each for his Attack.

rules: Each head is its own hit: Guard, Vulnerable and every damage bonus apply to each one.
Guinevere's Queen's peace doesn't stop his heads.
